_meta.purpose: Controlled vocabulary for Faceless Video and Montage operator lanes (Opening Strategy + Background). The historical hook key remains a wire-compatible alias. Single source of truth for UI dropdowns, backend validation, and tests. Display label 'Auto (AI decided)' is NOT a paid-LLM mandate — AUTO resolves deterministically from product/recipe knowledge when available.

semantics.hook: Backward-compatible wire alias for the Faceless Opening Strategy; creative strategy/category only. It is not the approved sales-copy Hook and does not authorize unsupported product claims, medical guarantees, fabricated discounts, or fake scarcity.
semantics.opening_strategy: Visual/narrative opening treatment only. Actual Hook, Body/USP, CTA, and approved execution text remain exclusively in Copy Register V2.
semantics.background: Scene/environment visual intent only. Does not override product truth, packaging, product scale, avatar/reference policies, scene continuity, or compliance. Example: Pharmacy is environment direction, not pharmacist endorsement.

_meta.actor_profile: Faceless-only adult hands/forearms/partial-torso continuity profile. This is not an avatar or face selector.
